correctness.rationale: Direct C++17 base-k exhaustive enumeration of all \(3^8\) and \(4^8\) colour assignments, exact twelve-edge properness checks and all-source BFS proves every claimed finite distance. Independent Python recursion, direct legal recolour enumeration and D8 × S_k orbit-shell calculation independently agrees. C++ checks all distances without symmetry reliance. The two 24-vertex connected degree-two 3-colour components must be cycles. Exact pair-shell sum equals C(2160,2). The greedy Grundy-4 witness is checked explicitly. No infinite inference.

evidence: Cereceda–van den Heuvel–Johnson Theorem 6: any 3-chromatic graph has disconnected R3, not component size/type. Their Theorem 3 guarantees connectivity for k>=col(G)+2=5 here.

Bonamy–Bousquet 2013 Theorem 1 guarantees k-mixing for k>=Grundy(G)+1; explicit Wagner greedy order shows Grundy=4, so threshold 5. Theorem 2 applies at k>=tw(G)+2, not providing the exact four-colour radius or eccentricities.
ArXiv 2014 broader tree-decomposition theorems do not give exact Wagner R4 distances.
broader_coverage.reasoning: A generic connectivity theorem at k>=5 is inapplicable at k=4; generic nonconnectivity of chromatic 3-colorings does not imply R3=2C24. Even a broad diameter estimate does not determine exact twelve-move all-source radius and extremal count.

originality.rationale: The exact two C24 reconfiguration components and the self-centered nonregular R4(W) with diameter 12, full distance-shell census and 5160 antipodal unordered pairs were not present in the primary literature passages, published records and inspected source comparisons. Known chromatic-polynomial counts 48 and 2160 are expressly credited. General 3-chromatic nonmixing is a strict weakening of the exact two-cycle classification; Grundy or treewidth mixing bounds do not supply the sharp k=4 Wagner metric. Residual priority uncertainty remains for unindexed or inaccessible records.
residual_risks: Unindexed or inaccessible equivalent finite computation can exist; a failed search is not a uniqueness proof.
The original 1972 chromatic-polynomial paper was not inspected in full; no explicit metric data found in its accessible derivative formula.
The July 2005 report lacks a verified first-publication day; 2013-02-14 is the earliest precisely day-dated selected public arXiv preprint, not a claim that all related earlier work postdates it.

value.rationale: Canonical Wagner/Mobius ladder is a natural small nonplanar cubic, 3-chromatic graph. The exact k=3 to k=4 connectivity threshold is at the chromatic palette plus one, below the applicable generic Grundy sufficient threshold five. The transition from two C24 components to an irregular yet self-centered 2160-state graph with sharp diameter twelve, full metric shells and 5160 diametral pairs constitutes substantive reconfiguration information not contained in known chromatic counts or qualitative mixing results.
